item.title: MacReport Agent 0.7.0
item.description: English and Russian, a compact overview, per-action feedback, event history, alert thresholds and quiet hours. Live viewing starts separately from mouse and keyboard control and reconnects without replaying input. Recoverable cleanup and separately confirmed permanent deletion. TURN fallback supports an owner-configured server; no hosted relay is included.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.6.0
item.description: Direct Live screen viewing and remote control with owner-private iCloud signaling. Requires the local screen/control permissions and an unlocked awake Mac. This first release uses direct connections without a TURN relay; iCloud snapshots remain available for unsupported networks. Faster status updates and clearer widget timestamps.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.5.0
item.description: New bento overview and native sidebar, with Light, Dark and Follow System appearance. Includes agent-originated test push and alerts for repeated power-adapter transitions.

item.title: MacReport Agent 0.4.0
item.description: Open installed applications and control an unlocked Mac through direct taps, scroll, encrypted text and fixed keys. Requires a separate local control switch and macOS Accessibility permission.
